description: Declared overlap rules for the CelebA-Spoof manifests of M2 (shard 0 of the mirror's `test` split; correspondence with the official test split not verified). Each manifest is declared with its expected number of rows and SHA-256 (as written by `rgb_manifests.py build --dataset celeba_spoof`); a different or truncated manifest stops the check before any rule, and every row is validated against closed value sets. Severity 'must': a failure makes check-overlap exit with code 1. 'declared_not_checkable': a property that the copy cannot verify, stated with its reason. Dimensions: key (celeba_<5-digit row of the shard>), hash (SHA-256 of the PNG bytes). There is no subject, identity or video dimension. In disjoint rules every manifest of 'a' is compared with every manifest of 'b'; in subset rules each manifest of 'a' with the union of 'b'; in intersection rules the union of 'a' with the union of 'b'.

rules.description: no manifest lists the same row twice

declared exact duplicates: the shard has one pair of rows with byte-identical images (both bona fide); both rows are prepared training images, official fitting images and pooled fitting images; every other manifest has none

the prepared folders and the evaluation set are reproduced by the declared rule: per class, on the rows with image in row order, eval = spread(rows, 150), training = the first 1,500 remaining rows, validation = eval plus the next 300 rows (the original conversion procedure is not versioned)
the 300 evaluation images are prepared `_validation` images (the "official" test of the CNNs)
"official" CNN fitting and early-stopping images are disjoint and together equal the prepared `_training` folders
no early-stopping image of the "official" CNNs is a fitting image, by key or content hash
no fitting or early-stopping image of the "official" CNNs is a test or evaluation image, by key or content hash

rules.reason: the copy has no identity field (the `path` column is empty and there is no subject column): fitting, early-stopping and test images all come from shard 0 of the mirror's `test` split and are divided per image, so identity overlap between them can neither be excluded nor measured
rules.description: identity disjointness of the "official" split (not checkable: the split is not guaranteed to be identity-disjoint; overlap can neither be excluded nor measured)

every image used by the checkpoints and the evaluation set is a row with image of shard 0 of the mirror's `test` split (correspondence with the official test split not verified): the "official" checkpoints are not trained on the official training split
the pooled fitting, early-stopping and test images are disjoint and together equal the images of the training cache
the "official" CNN test images are exactly the prepared `_validation` folders (450 per class)
declared leak: 244 of the 300 evaluation images were used to fit or early-stop the pooled CNNs
every key present in several manifests has the same label, label_name, row, official_split, sha256 and bytes in all of them

declared counts of every manifest (rows, bona fide, attacks), checked without scikit-learn: a subject moved between fitting and early stopping changes them; a swap of rows of the same class between two manifests does not (pinned only by the declared SHA-256 and by `reconstruct`)
